description: This file defines a Java interface named DataListener that declares a single method, onDataArrived, which is intended to be implemented by classes that need to handle incoming data represented as a byte array.

classes.name: DataListener
classes.description: A Java interface for classes that listen to data arrival events and implement the onDataArrived method.

methods.name: onDataArrived
methods.description: Method to be called when new data arrives; takes a byte array as input.
